Question: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barkaatuh ..Dear Mufti sahab, once i saw a dream in which i went in hell, me and some other person was also thr wid me. i was inside the surface of the eart, its like a cave, when i climbed up and went on surface, i saw its like a Desert area, no way 2 go, and some skeletons handling knifes in their hands, moving ahead 2 me, 2 kill me, and from that cave, big scorpians were coming out and biting my legs, and those skeleton almost reached near to me. and suddenly i woke up.. plz tell me the meaning of this dream, thank you!.. Answer ID: 11883 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 769/644=D/1430) The result and consequence of the sins and disobediences has been shown in the dream in which the human society is involved. It is necessary for every person to assess his actions and evaluate the engagements of this valuable life. Every one should strive to shun sins and bad deeds and get stability and firmness in iman and following the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
